visualCharacteristics.purpose: Article layout with an optional sidebar of article meta beside the article content

contentPattern.structure: Two-cell rows: cell 1 = sidebar meta (read time, date, written by, reviewed by, share links), cell 2 = article content (headings, text, lists, links, images, tables). One-cell rows: article content only. Without sidebar content the article is a single column

reuseGuidance: Keep promo bands, feedback and CTAs as separate blocks/sections; article-body only lays out meta and prose.
